pattern.typical_deadline_window: Paper registration/abstract in the first ~10 days of November, full paper deadline ~1 week later (2024-11-14 PT, 2025-11-13 AoE, 2026-11-16 AoE), supplementary +1 week. Deadlines are 'firm, no extension'.
pattern.typical_notification_month: Late February (2025-02-26, 2026-02-20, 2027-02-25). Reviews out ~Jan 22-25 with a one-week rebuttal.
pattern.typical_conference_month: June (2025: Jun 11-15; 2026: Jun 3-7; 2027: Jun 20-25); camera-ready late March.
pattern.location_rotation: Annual, always North America: Vancouver 2023, Seattle 2024, Nashville 2025, Denver 2026, Seattle 2027.
pattern.review_process: Double-blind on OpenReview: ~3 reviewers per paper, reviews released to authors, a one-week rebuttal (no paper revision), then AC/SAC decisions. All authors commit to review/AC when invited (since 2026 an enrollment form + OpenReview profile per author is required).
pattern.resubmission_rules: Dual submission: 'no substantially similar paper (20% or more overlap) has been or will be submitted to another conference or workshop during the review period'; journal submissions are treated the same. arXiv: preprints are allowed and 'we do not distinguish arxiv papers and other published papers' for the contemporaneous-work rule (work appearing <~2 months before the deadline need not be compared). A CVPR reject can go straight to ICCV (March) or ECCV (March, even years).

pattern.typical_deadline_window: Annual, two submission rounds. Round 1 paper deadline late June/mid July (2024-07-15, 2025-07-18, 2026-06-26); Round 2 paper deadline late Aug/mid Sep (2024-09-09, 2025-09-19, 2026-08-28), registration one week before each; supplementary +0-2 days. All AoE.
pattern.typical_notification_month: Round 1 decisions ~6-7 weeks after the deadline (Accept / Revise-and-Resubmit / Reject); final decisions for both rounds late Oct/early Nov (2024-10-28, 2025-11-05, 2026-10-09). Camera-ready Nov/Dec.
pattern.typical_conference_month: Winter: Feb 28-Mar 4 2025 (Tucson), Mar 6-10 2026 (Tucson), Jan 4-8 2027 (Lake Buena Vista/Orlando). Workshops the first two days, main conference the last three.
pattern.location_rotation: USA resort venues: Waikoloa HI 2023-2024, Tucson AZ 2025-2026, Disney Springs / Lake Buena Vista FL 2027.
pattern.review_process: Double-blind on OpenReview, three tracks (Algorithms, Applications, Evaluations & Datasets). Round-1 papers get Accept, Revise-and-Resubmit or Reject; R&R papers upload a revised paper plus a 1-page rebuttal at the Round-2 deadline and go back to the same reviewers/AC for a final decision with Round 2. Round-2 papers get one-shot decisions with no rebuttal.
pattern.resubmission_rules: 'Rejected round 1 papers which are submitted to round 2 as new papers will be desk rejected.' Dual submission: not previously published/accepted in substantially similar form and not under concurrent review. arXiv explicitly allowed ('Q. Can I post my submission on arXiv? A. Yes.'); an un-refereed arXiv report is not prior art. Round 1 (late June) suits ECCV/CVPR rejects; Round 2 (late Aug) suits ICCV/ECCV rejects.
